prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium wide shot, side-on, of the almost finished ark at grey dawn, its whole hull smeared pitch-black under a flat plank roof: four men in silhouette stand on the roof holding the last long plank between them above the one open gap left in it. Below, the camp of goat-hair tents lies still and quiet. Grey dawn light from the side, still air. Quiet and complete. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East before the flood: only goat-hair tents, open fires and torches on the open plain. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
